question: Can the production Base verifier deterministically prove whether one finalized native-USDC EIP-3009 settlement satisfies one strict x402 v2 exact PaymentRequirements intent, and expose the same honest verdict to humans and agents without adding any execution authority?
startingState: Session 8 shipped canary.0x402.sh as a live read-only Base transaction verifier on production commit 99ca351. It accepts only a transaction hash, compares two fixed server-owned Base RPC sources, and explicitly cannot prove intended x402 terms. The working tree is clean on feat/base-evidence-kernel at receipt commit 7ab41f9.
boundedChange: Add a pure strict x402 intent parser/evaluator and case-report hash, a same-origin machine-readable intent verification API that composes the existing fixed-source Base observation with caller-declared intent but never fetches caller input, and an accessible production UI for transaction hash plus PaymentRequirements JSON. Report exact field-level matches/mismatches, pending/not-observed/duplicate/contradiction/unavailable states, and retain every no-wallet/no-signing/no-payment/no-submission/no-retry/no-action boundary. Add deterministic fixtures, containment/security tests, docs, and production verification. Do not add contracts, wallets, settlement, arbitrary URLs/RPCs, user-controlled outbound targets, persistence, private evidence exposure, a duplicate Vercel project, or Bankr changes.
successCondition: A user and an agent can submit one canonical Base transaction hash plus one supported strict x402 v2 exact requirement and receive the same deterministic, hashed case report; the known production transaction yields matched for its exact observed fields, controlled field mutations yield explicit mismatch reasons, nonfinal/absent/duplicate/contradictory observations never yield matched, all existing containment guarantees remain true, the full suite passes, and the canonical production UI/API are verified live.
failureCondition: Any unsupported or ambiguous intent is silently accepted; any field mismatch can yield matched; a pending, absent, duplicate, failed, truncated, or contradictory observation can yield matched; caller input can select or trigger an outbound URL/RPC/method; any wallet/signing/payment/submission/retry/action capability appears; existing routes or production regress; or required live/API/browser/deployment receipts cannot be produced.
requiredReceipts: Passing deterministic unit, boundary, containment, typecheck, build, and diff checks
Reproducible local and production API requests showing one exact match and controlled mismatch reason codes
Desktop and mobile browser evidence for idle, validating, matched, and mismatch states with accessibility/console checks
Canonical Vercel deployment ID, production URL, commit, and post-deploy health/runtime evidence

events.note: Keep the verifier read-only and contract-free: caller intent is parsed as declarative evidence, never executed or fetched; only the transaction hash reaches the existing fixed-source Base collector.
